gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-host-grotesk: Pixelify Sans draws every letter with the thickness of neon glass tubing. It is built to announce, whereas Host Grotesk, with curves that sweep open, is built to stay out of the way underneath.

gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP finishes each curve in a clean, open gap, giving text a professional, approachable manner under Pixelify Sans. Both hold contrast low, one loudly and one quietly.
